summary: Wrote a 3-phase plan (1.25h) applying task 927's verbatim final-frame amendment text to the archived 901 paper-proof report. Phases split drift-only citation fixes (prose tier) from claim-changing replacements (prose tier) from a closure/invariant verification phase (full tier). Two issues were recorded as they arose: the deployed verify-touched.sh aborting on a stale suite map, and the research report's falsified closure site list.
